body:
## Data quality and maintainability foundation

- Used data validation and pipeline testing in the delivery workflow.
- Worked with explicit data transformations and downstream KPI dependencies.
- Built experience in production throughput, cloud ETL, distributed processing, and measured latency improvement.

This evidence supports Lohith's later pipeline mindset: changes must preserve data contracts, downstream consumers, repeatable processing, and observable outcomes. Do not claim specific agentic tooling at Cognizant.
